description: Control AdGuard Home, the network-wide ad and tracker blocker: pause protection and turn it back on, report its statistics, search the query log, block or allow domains, manage blocklists, DNS rewrites and clients, block services such as YouTube for one device, and turn safe search or parental control on or off. Start a workflow when protection is turned off or on, a domain is blocked or a new device appears.

adguard_home_domain_blocked_trigger.description: Runs when AdGuard Home blocks a domain (by a list, a rule, a blocked service, parental control or browsing security), for the domain or device you watch: once per domain and device each time it looks, with how many queries were blocked. Queries blocked before the workflow is turned on don't start it.

parameters.description: Only domains containing this, such as example.com, which also matches ads.example.com. Leave blank for every domain.
parameters.name: domain

parameters.description: Only queries from this device: its IP address, ClientID or persistent client name, as the Query Log shows it. Leave blank for every device.
parameters.name: device

adguard_home_new_client_trigger.description: Runs when a device AdGuard Home hadn't seen before asks it something: one that wasn't in its query log, statistics or clients when the workflow was turned on. A device quiet for longer than the query log reaches back counts as new.

adguard_home_protection_changed_trigger.description: Runs when AdGuard Home's protection is turned off (from its menu, by a timer or by another app) or back on, or only one of the two. A pause shorter than the workspace's polling interval may be missed.

parameters.description: Only when it's turned off, or only when it's turned back on. Leave blank for both.
parameters.name: change
